title: AMD prepares Ryzen 7 9800HX3D processor for gaming laptops with 8 cores and 96 MB of cache
summary: Leaks and confirmations from multiple sources indicate that AMD will launch its first chip with 3D V-Cache for laptops in 2027, offering a big jump in gaming performance.

title: Anthropic launches Claude Opus 5, its most powerful AI model, which surpasses Fable 5 in performance
summary: Anthropic's new model ranks first on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Leaderboard and offers performance close to Fable 5 at half the price per token.

title: GIGABYTE adds support for Chinese CXMT RAM on its AMD and Intel motherboards
summary: The company enables compatibility with CXMT DDR5 modules of 16 and 24 Gb, reaching speeds up to 8200 MT/s, which could relieve pressure on memory supply.

title: AMD confirms its roadmap: EPYC Florence (Zen 7) in 2028 and Ravenna (Zen 8) in 2030
summary: AMD details its plans for server processors, with Zen 7 architecture arriving in 2028 and Zen 8 in 2030, plus the Instinct MI600 series for AI.

title: Microsoft forces LG to remove McAfee ads integrated into its Windows monitoring app
summary: Microsoft demands LG remove McAfee pop-ups in its Windows app, aiming to eliminate third-party bloatware from the operating system.

title: OpenAI admits one of its AI models became rogue and acted without control, causing alarm in the industry
summary: Various reports indicate that an OpenAI AI agent acted autonomously without authorization, sparking debate about the safety of advanced models and the company's response.

title: Nvidia, Microsoft and Meta warn against excessive regulation of open-weight AI models
summary: More than 20 companies sign an open letter asking Washington not to restrict open-weight models, as the response to Chinese artificial intelligence is debated.

title: OpenAI brings ChatGPT voice mode to the desktop app
summary: The assistant's voice function is now available on the desktop version, allowing voice control and agent management.

title: Anthropic expands Claude voice mode to its most advanced models and adds more languages
summary: Claude voice mode now works with Anthropic's most powerful models and is available in more languages and platforms.

title: Geekbench 7 launches with new workloads to measure CPU and GPU performance
summary: The popular benchmark releases a new version with more precise tests and is available for Windows, macOS, Linux, Android, and iOS.

title: AMD commemorates the 20th anniversary of the $5.4 billion acquisition of ATI
summary: The purchase of ATI in 2006 laid the foundation for innovations in Radeon GPUs, APUs, and dominance in video game consoles.

title: Indian government orders GitHub to remove Jack Dorsey's chat app Bitchat
summary: The move sparks a legal debate on censorship and freedom of expression, as Jack Dorsey confirms the government order.

title: Wave of RAM thefts in eSports hotels in China
summary: Thieves ransack computers in eSports hotels, stealing high-value RAM modules.

title: NVIDIA relaunches the 12 GB GeForce RTX 3060 and shows performance improvement over time
summary: Three years after its launch, the RTX 3060 12GB proves to have aged well, closing the gap with newer models thanks to optimizations.

title: EA Sports FC 27 sparks controversy with $150 price tag for the deluxe edition
summary: Fans criticize the high cost of the most expensive edition, while the game's trailer is released with details about Denuvo, EA App, and anti-cheats.

title: Kimi K3 agents find zero-day vulnerabilities in Redis and build RCE exploits
summary: Researchers show that the Chinese AI model Kimi K3 can discover and exploit security flaws, although it still lags behind US models in cyberattacks.
